title: Nasruddin Tale 175: The Sultan's Ring
summary: The Sultan asked Nasruddin to inscribe a motto on his royal signet ring that would make him humble in times of prosperity and comforted in times of sorrow....
full_text:
The Sultan asked Nasruddin to inscribe a motto on his royal signet ring that would make him humble in times of prosperity and comforted in times of sorrow.

Nasruddin had the jeweler carve four ancient words: "This Too Shall Pass."

The Sultan wept and embraced the sage, realizing that all earthly glory and sorrow are transient waves upon the eternal sea of time.
moral: In victory remain humble; in defeat remain hopeful; for this too shall pass.
